beats.text: Standard summarization is the villain. It forces a full re-prefill of your entire context history every time you trim.
beats.visual_focus: A document being shredded and re-typed repeatedly.

beats.text: Cache Engineering stops the rewrite. We surgically manipulate the active KV cache states directly without touching the original trajectory.

feynman_certification.listener_verdict: The hook was solid—calling out the 'bloated graveyard' of tokens is exactly what happens when you're debugging long-context agents. I liked that you didn't waste time with a 'Hey guys' intro. I got lost for a second on 'repos'—I assume you mean re-positional encoding, but just saying 'repos' sounds like a git command or a weird shorthand. Otherwise, it's actually technical and doesn't treat me like a toddler.
